records.text: Steven Forker writes: "Candace (Candace Owens), I've been a supporter of Trump (Donald Trump) since 2016, but after Charlie's (Charlie Kirk's) death and the complete lack of transparency—is this still the same Trump (Donald Trump) that Charlie (Charlie Kirk), you, and millions of others voted for and believed in?"
records.speaker: Candace Owens
